title: CS1-WINDOW: cyclic-window collimation with source-aligned decoding

claims.statement: For every integer N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, put n = ceil(log2 N). The single CS1-WINDOW algorithm in proof.md recovers the whole s with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 from independent ideal coset copies. On EVERY branch, including failures, retries, discards and aborts, total charged sequential work is O(n^3 2^(sqrt(2n))). The declared envelope is n^3 2^(a sqrt n), with the exact a = . All four resource bounds and tolerance hold jointly for the same configuration, with absolute outside constants. The exact growth index of this envelope is 1/2.

On EVERY branch, including failures, retries, discards and aborts, fresh source acquisitions are at most the explicit Qcap = O(n^(5/4) 2^(sqrt(2n) - 16 (2n)^(1/4))) on the main branch, and N(n+10) on the finite branch. This includes every discarded and rejected copy. The declared envelope is 2^(a sqrt n - 19 n^(1/4)), with the exact a = . All four resource bounds and tolerance hold jointly for the same configuration, with absolute outside constants. The exact growth index of this envelope is 1/2.

The same CS1-WINDOW configuration proves source error tolerance epsilon(n)=0. Every acquired source copy must be an independent ideal coset state. Under that promise, full-secret success is at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 for every N and s, jointly with all four branchwise resource bounds. No positive malformed fraction is claimed.
